en.headline: Police arrest 34-year-old man over pinhole cameras in Sha Tin gym
en.dek: Three suspected hidden cameras were found in changing rooms at a 24/7 Fitness branch on Lek Yuen Street; the local man remains in custody.
body: Hong Kong police arrested a 34-year-old local man in Sha Tin on Sunday in connection with three suspected pinhole cameras found in the changing rooms of a 24/7 Fitness gym on Lek Yuen Street.

Officers were first alerted on Friday afternoon after a member noticed a suspicious object taped to the false ceiling of one cubicle. A search of the premises uncovered identical devices in two other changing rooms. The cameras had been wired into the ceiling lighting circuits.

Police classified the case as voyeurism and said the suspect remained in custody as investigations continued. The gym operator said it had reported the discovery immediately, checked other branches and would fully cooperate with the inquiry.

zh.headline: 沙田健身室更衣室藏針孔鏡頭 34歲男涉窺淫被捕
zh.dek: 24/7 Fitness瀝源街分店三間更衣室發現懷疑偷拍裝置，本地男子周日在沙田區落網，現正扣查。
body: 警方周日在沙田區拘捕一名34歲本地男子，涉嫌在沙田瀝源街一間24/7 Fitness健身室的更衣室安裝針孔鏡頭，案件列作窺淫。
周五下午一名會員在更衣室假天花發現用黑膠紙黏住的可疑物件，職員拆下後報警。人員到場再在另外兩間更衣室檢獲同類裝置，電線接駁至天花燈位電路。
涉案男子正被扣查，調查仍在進行。健身中心表示已即時報警，並巡查其他分店，會全力協助警方查明真相。
